analysis.title: Gradient Document Processing Landing Page
analysis.notes: A restrained black-and-white SaaS layout is energized by a cyan-to-orange gradient and a central stack of glowing, extruded geometric slabs. The hero uses a large left-aligned headline, compact right-side supporting copy, and a lower white promotional card to create strong vertical rhythm.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create an abstract 3D hero visual for a technical software landing page: several thick, beveled rectangular slabs arranged in a precise horizontal procession, with dark graphite forms on the left and vivid magenta, violet, coral, and warm yellow forms on the right. Add a luminous white-orange core between the layers, subtle extrusion, soft ambient shadows, and crisp studio lighting. Place the object centrally over a smooth full-width gradient transitioning from cyan through periwinkle and pink to orange. Clean, premium, geometric, no text, no logos, no symbols.
